headline: Exchange rates at the start of the week: what is happening at banks and exchange offices
summary: The dollar-to-hryvnia rate at Ukrainian banks fell by 4 kopiykas on Monday, 10 August, to 45.01 hryvnias per dollar, according to vesti-ua.net. Exchange offices reflected the same move at the start of the week.
why: The hryvnia is Ukraine's currency, and its exchange rate against the dollar affects import costs, inflation and foreign-currency pricing.
